summary_1line: Dhritarashtra renounces the palace for forest life; the royal family and citizens lament, and Kunti decides to accompany him and Gandhari.

image_candidates.scene_text: Kunti walks ahead guiding the blindfolded Gandhari by the shoulder while the aged blind Dhritarashtra follows with his hand resting on Gandhari as mourners surround them.
Women of Hastinapura pour into the streets weeping as Dhritarashtra, dressed in bark and deer-skin, slowly leaves the palace for the forest.
Yudhishthira collapses in grief before the departing Dhritarashtra while the Pandavas and courtiers stand around with tear-filled eyes.
